title: The road east at dusk
logline: The logging road at dusk, two days after the girl walked up it: empty, the glow above the trees, a zine's page blown against the gate's chain. The page lets the summer go up the road.

panels.composition: A gravel logging road at dusk climbing toward trees with a warm glow above them, a chained gate with a loose zine page caught against the chain, no one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a gravel logging road at dusk climbing toward trees with a warm glow above them and a chained gate with a loose paper page caught against the chain, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: The summer goes up the road.
